What is the 3-3-3 Rule in Social Media?

Creating content consistently is important but creating the right mix of content is what drives real results.

The 3-3-3 Rule is a simple yet effective content strategy that helps businesses maintain a balanced social media presence while building trust, engagement, and conversions.

Here's how it works:

3 Educational Posts
Share valuable tips, industry insights, how-to guides, and answers to common customer questions. Educational content positions your brand as an expert and keeps your audience coming back for more.

3 Engaging Posts
Encourage conversations through polls, questions, behind-the-scenes content, customer stories, quizzes, and interactive posts. Engagement helps strengthen your community and increases your content's reach.
